description: This PHP class, RouteManager, manages the loading and caching of route configurations using Symfony components. It loads route definitions from YAML files for various plugins in the system.

classes.name: RouteManager
classes.description: Manages the retrieval and caching of route collections by loading plugin route YAML files.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the route collection, loading and caching it if not already initialized.
